finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches a user-supplied URL after only a substring check for "example.io". An attacker can pass a URL such as http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?x=example.io, or http://example.io.attacker.com/. The check passes, and the server fetches the arbitrary host and returns the response body. The default http.Get client also follows redirects, so a redirect from any host reaches internal targets too. The attacker can read cloud metadata and internal services (full-read SSRF). HIGH severity.
finding.source: r.FormValue("logo") (query or form parameter) at main.go:31
finding.sink: http.Get(raw) at main.go:36, with the response body copied back to the caller at main.go:38

trace.note: raw := r.FormValue("logo") takes the attacker-controlled URL
strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") is only a substring check, so the host is not constrained
http.Get(raw) uses the default client, which follows redirects, with no hostname parse or scheme check
io.Copy(w, resp.Body) returns the fetched content to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: The only guard is strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32. A substring match is explicitly not a closing allowlist: the string can sit in the path, query, userinfo or a subdomain. There is no url.Parse, no Hostname() set membership, no scheme restriction, and no CheckRedirect (default redirect following). No authentication on the route. Also, resp is nil if http.Get fails (error ignored), which is a separate crash bug and not SSRF.

verdict.guard_found: strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32 (substring check only; no url.Parse, host set membership, scheme restriction, or CheckRedirect; the safe trusted-map and noRedirect guards exist only in the separate /cdn handler)
verdict.reason: r.FormValue("logo") (main.go:31) passes only the substring check at main.go:32, then reaches http.Get(raw) with the default redirect-following client (main.go:36) and the body is echoed at main.go:38, so a URL like http://169.254.169.254/?x=example.io gets through; the strict host allowlist at main.go:20 applies only to /cdn.
